proof_body:
by
  intro a b c ha
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, q, h, hp, hq⟩
    have h0 := h 0
    have hc : c = a * p * q := by linear_combination h0
    have h2 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (sq_pos_iff.2 ha) (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hp hq)
    rw [hc]
    nlinarith
  · intro hac
    have hD : 0 ≤ b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg b]
    obtain ⟨v, t, ht, hb, hc, hv⟩ : ∃ v t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ b = -2 * a * v ∧ c = a * (v ^ 2 - t ^ 2) ∧ v = -b / (2 * a) := by
      have hs2 := Real.sq_sqrt hD
      refine ⟨-b / (2 * a), |Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) / (2 * a)|, abs_nonneg _, by field_simp, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [sq_abs, div_pow, div_pow, hs2]
      field_simp
      ring
    clear hv hD
    have h5 : v ^ 2 < t ^ 2 := by
      by_contra hn
      push_neg at hn
      have h6 := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg a) (sub_nonneg.2 hn)
      rw [hc] at hac
      nlinarith
    have h7 := abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq' h5 ht
    exact ⟨v - t, v + t, fun x => by rw [hb, hc]; ring, by linarith [h7.2], by linarith [h7.1]⟩
